 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests are run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/):
+
+```bash
+pip install pytest
+pytest
+```
+
+Run a single file or test with:
+
+```bash
+pytest tests/test_pricing_cache.py
+pytest tests/test_pricing_cache.py::test_lookup_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
